surface_notes.atlas/mobile: Atlas explicitly falls back at 720px. The capture records the rendered fallback.
surface_notes.dispatcher/mobile: The empty state opens Chat with the mobile control. Populated states show the actual activity rail.
surface_notes.dispatcher/streaming: A real persisted routing receipt points to a conversation progressing through provider events.
surface_notes.dispatcher/long-error: The activity rail shows a long blocked conversation and a separate failed routing receipt.
surface_notes.conversation/empty: A saved conversation with no transcript.
surface_notes.tiled/empty: Two saved conversations with no transcript.
surface_notes.tiled/streaming: One visible conversation renders a live provider message.
surface_notes.tiled/long-error: One visible conversation renders a failed long transcript and its error.
surface_notes.queue/empty: No open, resolved, or snoozed asks.
surface_notes.queue/long-error: A failed resolution leaves the long ask and the entered text visible.
